title: Fix the Unchecked File Open
description: The program should open a file for reading and handle the case where it doesn't exist.
expectedBehavior: If the file doesn't exist, the program should print a clear error message instead of crashing.
actualProblem: fopen() returns NULL when it can't open the file (e.g. it doesn't exist), but that return value is never checked. Passing a NULL FILE* to fgets() dereferences NULL internally and crashes the program.
explanation: fopen() signals failure by returning NULL rather than throwing an exception. That return value must always be checked before the FILE* is used, or a missing/inaccessible file leads straight to a crash.
